name: My puppy: Black Labrador
summary: Your loyal Black Labrador is waiting for you in mixed reality! Calm, smart, and full of heart, this dog loves every moment spent by your side. Feed it delicious biscuits and tender chicken legs to keep it happy and strong. Throw a ball or toy bone and enjoy its quick, eager responses. When you reach to stroke its sleek black fur or give a belly rub, it’ll close its eyes in peaceful joy. Together, you’ll create memories filled with warmth, trust, and love—right in your own space.
